description: The specialist prompt library: ready-made instructions for audits, campaign builds, search term work, tracking checks, repairs and client reports, in English, Russian and Ukrainian (query lang=en, ru or uk). Each answers id, title and body; run the body as your own instructions. Offered to the operator who maintains the library, so an empty list means this organization has none rather than that something went wrong. -- MakeHybrid API plan, GET /google-ads/v1/prompts, group google-ads.
